{"id":1905889627,"question_id":3260,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770058708,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1905889627/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Divide an Array Into Subarrays With Minimum Cost II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long minimumCost(vector<int>& nums, int k, int dist) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        ll cost = nums[0];\n        int need = k-2;\n        ll mincost = LLONG_MAX;\n\n        priority_queue<ll , vector<ll> , greater<ll>>pq;\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<nums.size()-1; i++)\n        {\n            int second_elem = nums[i];\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<dist ; j++)\n            {\n                if(j + i + 1 < n) pq.push(nums[j + i + 1]);\n            }\n            ll sumofnext = 0;\n            sumofnext += second_elem;\n            int req = need;\n            while(req--)\n            {\n                sumofnext += pq.top(); \n                pq.pop();\n            }\n            if(sumofnext + cost < mincost)\n            {\n                mincost = sumofnext + cost;\n            }\n        }\n        return mincost;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"divide-an-array-into-subarrays-with-minimum-cost-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1633}
